headline: Ravens’ Lamar Jackson, Cam Jurgens To Miss Week 5

headline: Giants expect Nabers, Thomas, Skattebo and Likely to play Sunday
summary: New York Giants wide receiver Malik Nabers is expected to play Sunday against the Washington Commanders after missing a practice earlier in the week because of knee soreness.

headline: Chargers LT Rashawn Slater on IR following ankle surgery
summary: The Chargers are placing Rashawn Slater on injured reserve after the left tackle had surgery for a high ankle sprain. Los Angeles will be without three of its starting offensive linemen against the Broncos on Sunday.

headline: How wild-card game sent Bears, Packers in opposite directions
summary: Ever since Chicago sent Green Bay home, the Bears have taken flight and the Packers can't find their footing.

headline: Can the Seahawks' defense again silence the 49ers' hot offense Sunday?
summary: Seattle's defense stole the show the past two times these teams met. But the 49ers and Brock Purdy are on a roll heading into Week 5.
